flavor: A vast, circular chamber where the walls are not stone, but a mosaic of bleached ribcages and hollowed skulls. In the center, a single, pristine silver bell hangs from a strand of braided hair, perfectly still despite the stagnant air.
name: The Ossuary of Echoes
reason: The bell's chime is said to allow the listener to speak with the last thought of a dying god, but the silence of the room is heavy enough to crush the spirit.
